title: Why Big Tech's Tax Breaks Are Under Fire

scenes.text: Big Tech just lost a $517 million tax break in Pennsylvania.
The Pennsylvania government voted against continuing substantial tax incentives for tech companies.
This move reflects growing concerns about corporate influence and financial responsibility.
Citizens want accountability; it's time for change in tech policies.
